answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. Claiming a slot means burning twice the expected 30-day earnings, say 60 POA. Each burn is posted on a lantern board, so fakes cannot hide. Slots open slowly, like a river through a narrow gate. 100 fakes cost 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA burned, far more than they could earn. An honest agent pays once and keeps its slot, its rewards undiluted. Crystal clear: one deposit, one slot.
